'''Quold runium''' was a chemical liquid used in the the pressurization system of [[Collor Pondrat/Legends|Collor Pondrat's]] [[Plug-F Mammoth Split-X engine/Legends|Plug-F Mammoth]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]]. The pressurization system used by the company was patented.
